metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: SOSXEE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C39 H37 Cl2 Ho3 N6 O12 2+,2(Cl1 1-),5.5(H2 O1),0.5(C1 H4 O1). From the CIF bond table, Ho1 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho2 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho3 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.541-3.556 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.96-98.64°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ho3(o-dppd)3(μ3-OH)2(H2O)4Cl2]Cl2·0.5MeOH·5.5H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
